name: Gunner Conscript
oracle_text:
Trample
This creature gets +1/+1 for each Aura and Equipment attached to it.
When this creature dies, if it was enchanted, create a Junk token.
When this creature dies, if it was equipped, create a Junk token.
blocked_sentences: When this creature dies, if it was equipped, create a Junk token.

needs.what: a value key, the Equipment twin of `auras_had`, that reads on a departure (dies) trigger how many Equipment were attached to the creature as it left, so 'if it was equipped' is a trigger `condition` cmp `{"equipment_had": true}` > 0
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `zones._equipment_had` already snapshots the count as the creature leaves, but only folds it into `was_modified`; it is not put on the DIES event data nor in the trigger binding list (triggers.py binds `had_auras`, `had_counters`, `had_power`, `had_toughness`, `had_keywords` but no Equipment snapshot), and no value key reads it. `auras_had` covers the sibling 'if it was enchanted' line only, and a live `equipped` selector at resolution sees a graveyard card with nothing attached
